missing_methods.intent: Locate user profile name in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate and return the user profile name element from the dashboard header. This method should wait for the profile name element to be visible and return the WebElement or text content for assertion purposes.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'user_profile_name' element to be visible using page.locator(self.locators['user_profile_name']).wait_for(state='visible')
Get text content from 'user_profile_name' element using .text_content() or .inner_text()
Return the text content or WebElement for assertion purposes

missing_methods.intent: Assert user profile name is visible in dashboard header top right
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Verify that the user profile name is visible in the dashboard header top right section. This method should locate the profile name element, assert its visibility, and optionally validate that it matches the expected username parameter. Should return True if visible and matching, False otherwise.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'user_profile_name' element to be visible using page.locator(self.locators['user_profile_name']).wait_for(state='visible')
Get text content from 'user_profile_name' element using .text_content() or .inner_text()
Compare retrieved text with expected_username parameter
Return True if element is visible and text matches expected_username, False otherwise
